text:
maya - marketing lead: Quick sync — Saffron case brief ready for interviews? Need publish checklist + legal signoff by next Wed.
sam - producer: We're penciled for customer interview Mon 10am PT. Diego confirmed availability.
maya - marketing lead: Awesome. Diego, can you share a short bulleted list of outcomes Saffron saw (metrics or quotes) before the call? That helps the interviewer.
diego (customer): happy to. High-level: 3x throughput, 42% cost drop after migration, and better tail latency. Can share exact numbers during interview. 👍
jin - product marketer: If possible, capture the before/after baseline for throughput and cost. We want a chart for the launch post.
sam - producer: Interview plan: 20m customer Q&A + 10m for quote drafting. I'll capture audio and transcript, then draft 2 quote variants for legal.
lex - legal: Heads up — we'll need a short release form signed (no surprises). Send the transcript and quote drafts; we'll run quick redlines same day. Can we get materials 24h after interview?
sam - producer: Yes. My deliverable timeline: raw audio + transcript by Tue EOD, quote drafts by Wed morning.
maya - marketing lead: Timeline ok. Comms: plan for launch post + 2 social snippets + webinar slot mention. Tara, any asset constraints?
tara - design: I'll reserve a case study hero image slot and template. Need final approved quote + logo usage guidelines from Diego by Thu so I can finalize.
owen - sales: Also flagging inbound lead routing: anyone who downloads case brief should get routed to AE queue and receive the webinar invite. Can ops help wire that?
maya - marketing lead: Noted. I'll create the SFDC campaign and trigger. @comms-bot please add a followup action to assign leads to Owen's queue once the brief’s gated form is live.
comms-bot: Action created: "Saffron case brief - assign leads to owen.sales" · due 2026-04-07
sam - producer: Quick draft snippet for legal review — can we get eyes on this? ```"Redwood Inference reduced Saffron's per-token cost by 42% while improving 99th percentile latency, enabling near real-time responses for their app."``` Thoughts?
lex - legal: I'll review but flag: avoid exact proprietary phrasing without approval. If Saffron provides the 42% figure, we need explicit written approval in the release form. Otherwise mark as "approximately 40%".
diego (customer): I can sign off on the 42% and the latency line. I'll attach the internal report excerpt after the interview for verification.
jin - product marketer: Great — once legal confirms wording, I'll craft two headline options: one benchmark-focused, one customer outcome-focused.
maya - marketing lead: Can we also mention upcoming webinar where Diego will join as a guest? We should get a tentative date before publishing.
sam - producer: Suggest Wed two weeks from now for the webinar. Diego, any days that won't work?
diego (customer): Weekdays ok, prefer mornings PT. Two weeks from Mon works for me.
maya - marketing lead: Perfect. I'll lock webinar: Wed (two weeks out) 9:30am PT tentative. Owen — we'll add webinar CTA to lead nurture.
owen - sales: Got it.
tara - design: Putting a placeholder banner in the schedule. Final assets due Thu before launch.
lex - legal: I'll prioritize quote clearance — expect redlines within 24h of receiving drafts.
sam - producer: After legal signoff I'll produce two quote variants and a 500-word case brief draft. Everyone please review within 48h.
maya - marketing lead: Summary action items: 1) Sam -> run interview Mon 10am PT. 2) Diego -> provide baseline numbers + post-interview report. 3) Sam -> transcript + quote drafts by Tue/Wed. 4) Lex -> legal signoff within 24h of drafts. 5) Tara -> design assets finalized Thu. 6) Maya -> SFDC campaign + webinar RSVP + lead routing. 7) Owen -> AE followup ready. 
maya - marketing lead: Anything missing?
jin - product marketer: Micro-ask: include a 2-slide one-pager for SDRs (quick talking points). Sam, can you draft from the interview?
sam - producer: Yep, will add a 2-slide talking points doc.
comms-bot: Reminder set: "Check legal signoff" · 2026-04-08
maya - marketing lead: Thanks team. I'll post the official launch calendar entry after legal clears the quotes. :rocket:
